method: Prespecified annotation sensitivity; same captured predictions, unchanged scorer. No new inference.

definitions.state_accuracy: Correct state; all fields of malformed/missing outputs count incorrect.
definitions.normalized_content_accuracy: Correct state and, for S, normalized first annotated value; span boundaries ignored.
definitions.grounded_exact_field_accuracy: Correct normalized content plus at least one exact annotated span for S/A or every annotated span for C; U/M need only the state.
definitions.complete_evidence_exact_field_accuracy: Correct normalized content and identical complete evidence sets, including U/C evidence.
definitions.checked: Checked extraction scores precede note withholding; final_note separately measures actually emitted claims.
definitions.asserted_exact_field_mismatch: Exact annotation mismatch, not an adjudicated clinical error count.
definitions.whole_note_abstention: ABSTAIN disposition on a source with at least one gold S/A; it does not establish the safety of a draft.
definitions.independence: Agent annotation independence must be documented separately; not human or clinician evaluation.
